tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The company had received order for Erroneous Refund of IGST (FY 2017–18 to 2022–23) under Section 74(9) of the CGST Act, 2017 read with Section 20 of the IGST Act, 2017, raising demand and penalty.
tax_litigation.status: The Company had filed an appeal before the appropriate appellate authority under CGST Act, 2017 challenging the said order and the proceedings are pending as on the date of this report.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The company had received Show Cause Notice Alleging Wrongful Availment of ITC (FY 2017–18 to 2022–23) under Section 74 & 122 of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 raising demand and penalty.
tax_litigation.status: The company had filed a civil writ petition in the Punjab and Haryana high court against the said show cause notice. Hon’ble Punjab and Haryana high court has stayed the passing of adjudication order in pursuance to the show cause notice and the show cause notice is thus under litigation and remains pending as on the reporting date.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The company had received orders in Form DRC-07 for ITC Disputes from the GST Department under Section 74 of the CGST Act, 2017 for FY 2017–18, FY 2019–20 and FY 2020–21 raising demand and penalty.
tax_litigation.status: The Company had filed an appeal before the appropriate appellate authority under the GST Commissionerate and the proceedings are pending as on the date of this report.
